checks.finding: README, decision and durable objective preserve scholarly evidence -> alternative comparison -> design selection -> thesis -> downstream ARGO prototype. A manuscript artifact alone is not completion; simple winning designs are allowed.

Frozen C0 feasibility is distinguished from B/C/G; existing A/A2 preparation/approval is preserved. Current zero-start observation, unobserved score, costs not certified, and FG/CUSTODY/ACCESS scope agree with latest P0 disposition. No blocked execution bypass is proposed.

Exactly three new full extracted-text reviews are used; two downloads are not relabelled read. All new sources remain preprints with no verified peer-reviewed venue and no local reproduction. Synthesis agrees with the reviewed mechanism/limitations rather than importing author results as local efficacy.

Common recovery/evidence/scheduler rights remain matched. C-B identifies mandatory-process package and G-C graph-control package, explicitly not topology alone. Single locked final hidden artifact remains primary. Future selection, native construction and acceptance remain unexecuted.

Three retained source hashes, byte sizes and LF lengths match; review targets and local Markdown links exist; all scoped map edge endpoints resolve. The map marks future evidence and is explicitly not the canonical runtime graph. ORX keeps scientific lifecycle ownership; research graph does not create a second run registry.
